articles.title: UK's New Social Media Ban: What Happens to Roblox and YouTube?
articles.summary: The UK is banning under-16s from apps like TikTok and YouTube. But what about Roblox? The government hasn't decided yet, and kids are waiting to see if their favorite games will be blocked.

articles.title: Working Parents Feel Torn: 'No Way to Be Two Things at Once'
articles.summary: A new survey shows most working moms and dads feel they can't give 100% at home or at work. Amber Petersen, a mom in Iowa, says she's always pulled between her kids and her job—and she's not alone.

articles.title: Why Ships Aren't Rushing Through the Strait of Hormuz Yet
articles.summary: President Trump said the Strait of Hormuz is open again, but ships aren't moving. There are still dangers like mines and attacks, so captains are waiting to see if it's really safe.
